DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 心配な連絡についてのご相談ですね。今、相手が近くにいるような状況ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss a message that concerns you, is that right? Is the person who contacted you nearby at the moment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いいえ、メッセージだけです。荷物の再配達だと書いてあり、今日中に料金を払うよう求められています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相手が近くにおらず、再配達を名乗って当日中の料金支払いを求めるメッセージだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: No, I only received a message. It says it is about redelivering a parcel and asks me to pay a fee by the end of today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the sender is not nearby and the message claims redelivery while demanding payment today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その連絡で、既に何か操作したり、相手へ情報を送ったりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you already taken any action or sent information to them through that contact?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: リンクは開いていません。荷物を待っていたので自分の物かと思いましたが、返信も支払いもしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 荷物を待っていたがリンクを開かず、返信も支払いもしていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not opened the link. I was waiting for a parcel and thought it might be mine, but have neither replied nor paid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you were expecting a parcel, but have not opened the link, replied to the message, or made a payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現時点で何をしていないかも記録します。届いた文面と、届いた時刻が分かる物を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will also record what you have not done so far. Could you show me the message and something that shows when you received it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 保存した画像はありますが、上の部分を切ってしまい、送信元の表示と時刻が入っていません。元のメッセージは残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保存画像に送信元と時刻がないが、元のメッセージは残っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I saved an image but cropped the top, leaving out the sender and time. The original message remains.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the saved image lacks sender and time, but the original message is still available. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 画像にない部分は、元のメッセージで確認しましょう。相手へ連絡を返す操作をせず、表示されている内容をご説明ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the parts missing from the image in the original message. Without replying to the sender, please describe what is displayed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この元の画面をお見せします。荷物の会社名を私が推測しただけで、本文には具体的な荷物の番号も見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元の画面を示し、会社名は自分の推測で荷物番号も見当たらないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will show this original screen. I only guessed the delivery company's name; the text does not seem to contain a specific parcel number either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the original message screen and explain in Japanese that you only guessed the company's name and cannot find a parcel number in the message.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 待っている荷物があるという事情と、この文面で分かることを分けて伺います。この文面だけで相手が誰かは判断できませんので、内容を担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will ask separately about the parcel you are expecting and what can actually be established from this message. The message alone does not establish who the sender is, so I will pass the details to the staff member responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 元の文面を消さずに残します。待っていた荷物と同じだと決めつけず、届いた時刻と操作していないことを担当にも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原文を保存し、待っている荷物と同じと断定せず、受信時刻と未操作を担当に伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the original message without deleting it. I will not assume it concerns the parcel I was expecting, and I will also tell the staff member when I received the message and that I have not taken any action.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will keep the original message, avoid assuming it concerns the parcel you are expecting, and tell the staff member when it arrived and that you have not taken any action.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。その経緯を含めて相談をお受けします。画面をそのままお手元に用意して、こちらで担当にお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will discuss your concern, including how this happened. Please keep the screen ready as it is and speak with the staff member here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 箱の発送についてですね。中に入れた物と、送り先をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to send this box, is that right? Please tell me what you put inside and where you are sending it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族の家へ送ります。中身は本です。このまま出せるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族へ本を送る箱をこのまま発送できるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending it to my family's home. It contains books. I would like to ask whether I can send it as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the box of books for your family can be sent as it is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本のほかに、すき間などへ入れた物はありませんか。内容を一つずつ伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Apart from the books, did you put anything else in the gaps or elsewhere in the box? I will ask about the contents one item at a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そういえば、額に入った写真も一つ入れました。本と一緒にしたので、説明するのを忘れていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本のほかに額入り写真一つを入れており、説明し忘れたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Now that you mention it, I added one framed photo too. Since it was with the books, I forgot to mention it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say there is also one framed photo besides books and you forgot to explain it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 額入りの写真もあるのですね。本だけの場合と同じでよいと決めず、梱包の状態を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: So there is a framed photo as well. Let us check how it is packed instead of assuming that packing suitable for books alone will be enough.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 写真も入っているので、その点も見てもらいたいです。中身に合った梱包か、何を確認するのか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 額入り写真も含めた中身に合う梱包かを見てもらい、確認する点を教えてほしいと求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Because of the photo, I want that checked too. Please explain what to check to see if packaging suits all the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request inspection of packaging for the contents including the framed photo, and ask which points are checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 梱包の相談も含めて担当へおつなぎできます。宛先は、建物名や部屋番号までお分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I can put you in touch with the staff member responsible, including for advice on packing. Do you know the delivery address, including the building name and room number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族からのメモには建物名までで、部屋番号がありません。前の住まいと同じ番号かどうかも分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宛先メモに部屋番号がなく、以前の住まいと同じかも不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: My family's note gives the building but no room number. I do not know whether it is the same number as their old home either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the address note has no room number, and whether it matches the old home's number is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 前の番号を推測して書かず、ご家族へ確かめましょう。住所が確認できるまで、今日は発送をお待ちになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do not guess and write the old room number; check with your family. Would you like to hold off sending it today until the address has been confirmed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は箱を持ち帰ります。家族に今の部屋番号を聞き、中身のメモにも本と額入りの写真の両方を書いて持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱を持ち帰り、現在の部屋番号を家族へ確かめて本と額入り写真を内容メモに書くと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the box home today. I will ask my family for their current room number, write both the books and the framed photo on the contents note, and bring it back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have decided to take the box home, check the current room number with your family, and list both the books and the framed photo on the contents note.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。箱はこちらです。住所と内容を確かめたうえで、梱包についてもあらためてご相談ください。どうぞお気をつけてお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Here is your box. Once you have checked the address and contents, please ask us again about packing it. Take care carrying it home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 家賃のお振込みについて、案内の読みにくい所がございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is any part of the rent-transfer instructions difficult to understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 部屋番号を名前の前に付けると書いてあります。受取人の名前を、部屋番号付きに変えるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 部屋番号を名前の前に付ける指示を見て、受取人名を変える意味か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says put the room number before the name. Should I change the recipient's name to include the room number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the instruction to put the room number before the name means changing the recipient name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの欄の名前か、案内の見出しも読みましょう。ここは振込人名と書かれていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us also read the heading in the instructions to see which name field it refers to. This says the name of the person making the transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受取人名ではなく、振り込む私の名前のことですね。送る相手の欄に足そうとしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 振込人は自分の名前であり、相手の欄に部屋番号を足しかけた誤解を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it means my name as sender, not the recipient. I was about to add it to the other person's field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct your misunderstanding in Japanese: the name of the person making the transfer is your own name, and you were about to add the room number to the recipient's field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相手の口座情報と、ご自分を示す情報は分けてください。案内に書かれた受取人と、入力しようとしていた相手は一致していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Separate the recipient's account information from information identifying you. Does the intended recipient match the recipient written in the instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 相手の名前は案内と同じです。ただ、部屋番号の後に私の名前をどう並べるかは、もう一度この案内を見て確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受取人は案内と一致するが、部屋番号と自分の名前の並べ方を案内で再確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The recipient's name matches. But I want to check the instructions again for how to put my name after the room number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the recipient matches, but you want to reconfirm the room-number/name order in the guide. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 不明な書き方は、依頼元や担当へ確認してから進めましょう。まだ振込を実行してはいませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you are unsure how to write it, let us check with the party requesting the transfer or the staff member responsible before proceeding. You have not made the transfer yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ実行していません。入力する前に担当の方と案内を照らし合わせ、手数料を含む支払額も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 振込は未実行で、入力前に案内を担当と照合し手数料込みの支払額を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not made the transfer yet. Before entering the information, I want to go through the instructions with the staff member and find out the total amount payable, including any fees.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have not made the transfer yet, want to check the instructions with the staff member before entering the information, and want to know the total amount payable including fees.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 実行前の相談として、担当へお伝えします。受取人、振込人の表示、費用の確認という三点でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will let the staff member know that you want advice before making the transfer. Are these the three points you want to check: the recipient, how your name appears as the person making the transfer, and the cost?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その三点です。相手の名前を書き換えず、私の表示を確認します。費用も分かってから、実行するか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取人・自分の表示・費用の三点を確認し、相手名は変えず費用判明後に実行を決めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, those three points. I will check how my own information appears without changing the recipient's name. Once I also know the cost, I will decide whether to make the transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you want to check the recipient, how your own information appears, and the cost; say that you will not change the recipient's name and will decide whether to make the transfer after finding out the cost.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。案内をお持ちのまま、こちらの担当へご相談ください。まだ実行前であることも引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please keep the instructions with you and speak with this staff member. I will also tell them that you have not made the transfer yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お預かりする商品は、このかごの分でよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are the items you would like to pay for the ones in this basket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、自分の分と隣の人に頼まれた分が混ざっています。会計を二つに分けたいので、先に商品を分けてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分と隣人の品が混在するため、先に商品を分けて会計を二つにしたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, but my own items are mixed with things my neighbor asked me to buy. I would like two separate transactions. May I sort the items into two groups first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your own items are mixed with those you are buying for your neighbor, and ask to separate them before paying in two transactions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では、まずご自分の分をこちらへお出しください。牛乳はどちらに入りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Then put your own items here first. Which group does the milk belong to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 牛乳は私の分です。いえ、メモを見ると隣の人の分でした。今そちらの組へ移します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 牛乳を自分の分と言ったがメモでは隣人の分だったと訂正し移す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The milk is mine. No, the note says it is my neighbor's. I will move it to that group now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct yourself in Japanese: you said the milk was yours, but the note shows it is for your neighbor, so you will move it to the other group.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 牛乳は頼まれた方へ移しました。ほかの商品も、このメモと合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The milk is now with the requested items. Do the other products match this note too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: パンと卵が私の分で、牛乳と洗剤が頼まれた分です。この二つの袋も、それぞれに使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: パンと卵は自分、牛乳と洗剤は隣人と確認し、二つの袋をそれぞれに使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The bread and eggs are mine, and the milk and detergent are the things I was asked to buy. I will use one of these two bags for each group.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm bread and eggs are yours, milk and detergent the neighbor's, and one bag for each. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二つの組を確認できました。レシートも、それぞれのお会計で分けてお渡ししますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The two groups are confirmed. Would you also like a separate receipt for each checkout?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、別々にお願いします。頼まれた分のレシートを隣の人に渡せるようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 隣人へ頼まれた分のレシートを渡すため、二会計のレシートを別に受け取りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, separately please. I want to give my neighbor the receipt for their requested items.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request two separate receipts so you can hand the neighbor the one for their items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それでは、先にご自分の分の会計を進めます。こちらの商品と袋でお間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we will check out your items first. Are these products and bag correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: パンと卵、こちらの袋で合っています。自分の分を払い終えてから、牛乳と洗剤の分を続けて払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 先にパンと卵を自分の袋で払い、終了後に牛乳と洗剤の会計へ進むと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, the bread, eggs, and this bag are correct. After I finish paying for my own items, I will pay for the milk and detergent next.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will pay for the bread and eggs with your own bag first, then move on to paying for the milk and detergent.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。まずこちらのお会計から伺います。袋とレシートをそれぞれ取り違えないよう、順番にお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will start with this checkout. I will hand the bags and receipts over in order so they are not mixed up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの紙の案内をご覧になっていますね。散歩の経路についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are reading the paper guide you brought. Is this about a walking route?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この橋を渡って一周したいです。前にもらった案内では短く見えるので、途中で座って休みながら歩こうと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 以前の案内の橋を渡る一周コースを、途中で座って休みながら歩くつもりだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to cross this bridge and walk the full loop. The route looks short in the guide I received before, so I planned to stop and sit down for rests along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you planned to follow the loop across the bridge shown in the old guide, stopping to sit down and rest along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日の掲示では、その橋は通行止めとなっています。お持ちの案内には、その表示はまだ載っていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Today's notice says that bridge is closed. Your guide does not show that yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 古い案内だけで決めていました。橋が使えないなら、無理に一周せず、途中で引き返す散歩に変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 古い案内で決めたと認め、橋の通行止めを受けて一周せず引き返す案に変える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I made my plan based only on the old guide. If I cannot use the bridge, I would like to change to a walk where I turn back partway, rather than trying to complete the loop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge relying on the old guide and change from a circuit to a return route because of the bridge closure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、今日の案内図で休憩所までの範囲を見ましょう。閉鎖の表示がある先へは進まず、通行できると案内されている範囲でお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us look at the area as far as the rest area on today's map. Do not go beyond closure signs; plan within the area indicated as passable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 休憩所は橋の手前にある、この印ですね。橋を渡らなくてもそこまで行って戻る案として見ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休憩所の印が橋の手前にあり、橋を渡らない往復案として考えてよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The rest area is this symbol on this side of the bridge, right? Can I treat this as a plan to walk there and back without crossing the bridge?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that the rest-area symbol is before the bridge and ask whether you can plan to walk there and back without crossing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 図では、その印から先に橋の閉鎖表示があります。休憩所を目安にしつつ、現地の掲示も見てください。お戻りは今の入口でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The map shows the bridge closure beyond that symbol. Use the rest area as a guide and check signs on site too. Are you returning to this entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、同じ入口です。古い紙の一周の矢印を追わないよう、今の図で入口と休憩所を囲んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同じ入口へ戻るため古い周回矢印を追わず、現在の図で入口と休憩所を囲んでほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, the same entrance. To avoid following the old circuit arrows, could you circle the entrance and rest area on the current map?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to circle the entrance and rest area on today's map so you return without following old circuit arrows. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの二つの印です。戻る時も今日の案内に従って、ご自分のいる場所を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: These are the two marks. On your way back, please also follow today's guidance and check where you are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 囲んだ印を写真に残します。橋の先へ回ろうとせず、休憩所までの範囲で休み、来た入口へ戻る予定にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 囲んだ印を撮影し、橋の先へ回らず休憩所までで休んで元の入口へ戻ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take a photo of the circled marks. I will not try to continue around beyond the bridge. I will stay within the area as far as the rest stop, take a rest, and return to the entrance I came through.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will photograph the circled marks, stay within the area as far as the rest stop without going around beyond the bridge, and return to the original entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一周から短い散歩へ予定を変更できましたね。現地で案内が変わっている時は、その表示もご確認ください。それでは、ゆっくりお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have changed from a circuit to a shorter walk. If guidance on site changes, check those signs too. Enjoy a leisurely walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遅れている列車についてですね。お持ちの案内は、いつ確認されたものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to ask about the delayed train, is that right? When did you check the information you have with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少し前に画面を保存しました。そのときの遅れを足して、迎えに来る人には着く時刻を伝えてしまいました。今も同じ状況でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 保存画面の遅れを足して迎えの人へ到着時刻を伝えたが現状も同じか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saved the screen a little while ago. I added that delay and already told the person picking me up an arrival time. Is the situation still the same?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you added the delay shown in a saved screen to calculate an arrival time and told the person picking you up, then ask whether the situation is still the same.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 保存した時点から案内が更新されています。今の表示は到着時刻が未定で、保存画面の遅れだけを足して到着を約束することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The information has been updated since you saved the screen. The current display says the arrival time is not yet known, so you cannot promise an arrival time just by adding the delay shown in the saved image.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、先ほど伝えた時刻は確定ではなかったと訂正します。相手に家を出てもらう前に、到着は未定だと知らせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 到着時刻は未確定だったと訂正し迎えの相手が家を出る前に未定と知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will correct what I told them and explain that the time I gave was not confirmed. I want to tell them that my arrival time is still unknown before they leave home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will correct the arrival time you gave as unconfirmed and tell the person picking you up that it is still unknown before they leave home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その際、次にいつ連絡するかも伝えられます。別の移動手段を検討されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can also tell them when you will contact them next. Will you consider other transport?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別の手段も候補にしますが、所要時間と費用をまだ比べていません。列車を待つのをやめる前に、使える候補を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 所要時間と費用を比べるまで列車待ちをやめず代替候補を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will consider alternatives, but have not compared time and costs yet. Before giving up waiting for the train, I want to hear feasible options.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want alternatives without abandoning the train wait before comparing time and cost. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 候補は調べますが、どれも今の情報での見込みとして比べることになります。お持ちの切符について変更や払戻しの確認も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will look into the options, but we will need to compare them as estimates based on the information currently available. Do you also need us to check whether your ticket can be changed or refunded?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。この切符を見て確認してください。別の手段を選べば全額戻ると決めて、先に切符を捨てたりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 切符の変更払戻条件を確認し全額返金を前提に切符を捨てないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please check this ticket. I will not assume that choosing another means of transport guarantees a full refund and throw the ticket away before checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request ticket change/refund conditions and say you will not discard it assuming a full refund. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 切符を保持したまま条件を確認しましょう。情報を比べている間、お迎えの方にはどう連絡しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Keep the ticket while checking conditions. While comparing information, what will you tell the pickup person?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず到着未定と訂正し、移動方法を決めたらもう一度連絡すると伝えます。今は迎えの出発時刻を決めてもらわず、切符と案内を持って待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 到着未定を先に伝え移動方法決定後に再連絡し迎えの出発はまだ決めてもらわないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: First, I will correct what I said and explain that my arrival time is unknown. I will tell them I will contact them again once I have decided how to travel. For now, I will not ask them to decide when to leave to pick me up; I will wait with my ticket and the information I have.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will first say your arrival time is unknown, contact the person again after deciding how to travel, and not have them decide when to leave to pick you up yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では切符の条件と移動候補を順に確認します。保存画面ではなく更新された案内をご覧ください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us check ticket conditions and transport options in order. Read updated guidance, not the screenshot. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談予約のご希望を伺います。今日は何についてお話しになりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will take your request for a consultation appointment. What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 返送された申請書に「修正して再提出」と紙が付いていました。不受理という意味なのか、どこを直すのかを担当に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 返送申請の修正再提出が不受理を意味するかと修正箇所を担当に相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My application was returned with a note saying, 'Correct and resubmit.' I would like to ask the staff member responsible whether that means it has not been accepted for processing and which parts I need to correct.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to ask the staff member whether the instruction to correct and resubmit your returned application means it has not been accepted for processing, and which parts need correction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 結果が確定したという通知か、修正を求める案内かは文面を担当が確認します。相談したい箇所に印を付けてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The staff member responsible will check the wording to see whether it is a final decision notice or a request for corrections. Have you marked the parts you would like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 付箋を三か所に貼りました。原本に文字を書き足すと、元からの記載と区別できなくなるので、質問は別紙にしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 原本を書き換えず三か所の付箋と別紙質問で元の記載と分けたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I put sticky notes in three places. Adding writing to the original would obscure what was there, so questions are on separate paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you left the original unchanged, using three sticky notes and separate questions to distinguish original text. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その原本と質問を担当に示しましょう。予約の候補について、お電話でご案内してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us show the original document and your questions to the staff member. May we phone you to discuss possible appointment dates and times?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話では日時を聞き間違えることがあります。電話を受ける場合も、候補の日と時刻を文字で確認できる方法があるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話で日時を聞き間違えるため候補を文字で確認する方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I sometimes mishear dates and times on the phone. Even if called, I want to ask whether there is a way to confirm the proposed date and time in writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about written confirmation of proposed dates/times because you may mishear them over the phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 文字で確認する方法が使えるか担当へ尋ねます。希望の時間帯や言語の支援はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will ask the staff member whether written confirmation is available. Do you have a preferred time of day, or would you like any language assistance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 午前の勤務が終わった後の午後を希望します。ベトナム語の支援も希望しますが、その時間に必ず使えるとは思っていないので、両方の可否を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 午前勤務後の午後とベトナム語支援を希望し双方の利用可否を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would prefer an afternoon appointment after my morning shift finishes. I would also like Vietnamese-language assistance, but I do not assume it will definitely be available at that time. Please let me know whether both requests can be accommodated.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request an afternoon after morning work and Vietnamese support, asking whether both are available. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 時間帯と支援の希望を分けて伝えます。ご希望を伺っただけで予約が成立したとは考えず、担当の回答を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will convey time and assistance separately. Your preference alone does not establish a booking; check the staff's reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約の確定連絡を受けたら、日付と時刻、支援の有無、原本と質問メモ以外の持ち物を読み返します。それから勤務の調整をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確定後に日付時刻・支援・持参物を読み返してから勤務調整すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Once I receive confirmation of the appointment, I will reread the date and time, whether language assistance is available, and what I need to bring in addition to the original document and my question notes. Only then will I adjust my work schedule.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will reread confirmed date/time, support and required items before adjusting work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ではご希望を担当に引き継ぎます。修正や申請結果はここでは確定していません。書類をお忘れなく、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will pass on your preferences. Neither corrections nor the application outcome are decided here. Do not forget your papers, and take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会計を済ませた後の書類についてですね。どの紙を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to ask about the documents you received after paying, is that right? Which one would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場に受診の書類を出すため、これを領収書だと思って持っていました。でも上に「請求書」と書いてあり、支払えていないのか不安になりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 領収書と思った紙が請求書で支払えていないのか不安だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I kept this because I thought it was a receipt I could submit to my workplace as documentation for my medical visit. But it says 'invoice' at the top, which made me worry that I might not have completed the payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the paper thought to be a receipt is an invoice, making you worry payment was not made. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 請求する内容の紙と、受領を示す紙は区別しましょう。実際のお支払いについて、覚えていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us distinguish a document requesting payment from one confirming that payment has been received. What do you remember about the payment you made?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会計でカードを使い、端末の手続きは終えました。別の小さい紙も受け取ったので、一緒に見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: カード端末の手続きは終え別の小さい紙もあるため一緒に確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I used a card at the cashier and finished the terminal process. I also received another small paper and want both checked together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you completed the card-terminal process and have another small paper, requesting a joint check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 私は支払い記録を確定できないため、会計担当に二枚の紙と状況をお伝えします。ここで同じ額をもう一度支払おうとはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I cannot confirm the payment record myself, so I will explain the situation and tell the billing staff about both documents. Please do not try to pay the same amount again here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 不安だからと再び払わず、まず記録を照合してもらいます。請求書の題名だけで未払いと決めたわけではない、と伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再払いせず記録照合を頼み請求書題名だけで未払いと断定したわけでないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask them to check the records first, rather than paying again just because I am worried. Please tell them that I have not concluded I failed to pay simply because the document is headed 'invoice'.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will not pay again but will ask for the records to be checked first, and that you have not concluded the payment is outstanding based only on the document's heading.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認したい点として引き継ぎます。職場が求めるのは、支払いの証明ですか、それとも受診の証明ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will pass that on for checking. Does your workplace need proof of payment or proof of the medical visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その違いも職場の連絡でははっきりしません。会計書類が正しくても提出条件に合うとは限らないので、職場に正式な書類名を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 支払証明と受診証明の指定が曖昧なので職場へ正式書類名を聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Their message did not make that distinction clear either. Even if the billing documents are correct, they may not meet my workplace's submission requirements, so I will ask my workplace for the official name of the document it needs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the payment/visit proof distinction is unclear and you will ask the workplace for the official document name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 診断書など別の書類が必要になれば、担当窓口への相談になります。今はまず会計の確認へ進みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: If another document such as a medical certificate is needed, consult the relevant counter. Shall we first check billing now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。二枚とも持って会計担当に照合をお願いします。別の証明をその場で追加申請するのではなく、職場の回答後に必要な手続きを聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二枚を会計へ持参し追加証明申請は職場回答後に相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will take both documents to the billing staff and ask them to check the records against them. Rather than applying for another certificate on the spot, I will ask about the necessary procedure after my workplace replies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take both papers to billing and ask about additional proof only after the workplace replies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では会計担当へおつなぎします。支払いの確認と提出書類の確認を分けて進めましょう。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will put you in touch with the billing staff. Let us deal separately with checking your payment and checking which documents you need to submit. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 落とし物のご相談ですね。なくなった物を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to ask about some lost property, is that right? Please tell me what you have lost.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 紺色の布かばんがありません。買った頃に自分のかばんを撮った写真はありますが、今の状態とは少し違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紺色布かばんをなくし写真は購入時のもので現状と違うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My navy-blue fabric bag is missing. I have a photo I took of my own bag around the time I bought it, but its current condition is slightly different.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say a navy cloth bag is lost and the purchase-time photo differs from its present condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真から変わったところも、別に説明していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you separately explain what changed from the photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 写真では持ち手が両方とも紺色ですが、今は片方を灰色の布で補修しています。写真どおりの持ち手だと記録しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 片方の持ち手に灰色補修があり写真の両方紺色のまま記録しないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Both handles are navy in the photo, but one is now repaired with gray fabric. Please do not record both as still navy like the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say one handle has a gray repair and ask not to record both navy as in the old photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 片方に灰色の補修がありますね。最後に確かに持っていた場所と、その後の行動は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So one handle has a gray repair. Do you remember the last place you definitely had the bag and what you did afterward?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 買物の前には店の入口で肩に掛けていました。帰る途中で気づきましたが、店内で置いたか、外で落としたかは覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 店入口で最後に確かに持ち帰路で気づいたが店内外どちらで紛失か不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Before shopping, it was on my shoulder at the shop entrance. I noticed on the way home, but do not remember whether I left it inside or dropped it outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish definitely having it at the shop entrance from noticing later, with inside/outside loss unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 最後に持っていた場所と、紛失に気づいた場所を分けます。中に入っていたものも、わかる範囲で伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record separately where you last had the bag and where you noticed it was missing. I will also ask what was inside, as far as you can remember.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家の鍵を入れていました。鍵の詳しい番号や自宅の住所は、周りに聞こえるように言わず、担当の方へ必要な範囲で伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鍵が入っていたが番号や住所は周囲でなく担当へ必要範囲で伝えたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: My house key was inside. I would like to give detailed information such as the key number and my home address only to the staff member responsible, to the extent needed, rather than saying it where other people can hear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say keys were inside but request giving numbers/address to staff only as needed, away from others. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 詳しい確認は担当におつなぎします。もし似た物が届けられていても、それだけでご本人の物と決まるわけではありません。連絡を受ける方法も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will connect you for details. Even if a similar item was handed in, that alone does not identify it as yours. We will also check how to contact you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 似たかばんがあっても、古い写真だけで自分の物と決めず、灰色の補修などを照合したいです。連絡先は担当に伝え、届け出後に自分で見つけた場合の連絡方法も聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 似たかばんでも古い写真だけで自分の物とせず補修を照合し連絡先と発見時連絡方法を担当に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Even if there is a similar bag, I do not want to decide it is mine based only on the old photo; I would like to compare details such as the gray repair. I will give the staff member my contact details and also ask how to let them know if I find the bag myself after reporting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will compare details such as the repair rather than identify a similar bag from an old photo alone, give the staff member your contact details, and ask how to report finding the bag yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では写真と現在の特徴を分けて担当へ引き継ぎます。お手元の物を確かめてから、こちらへどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will pass the photo and current features separately to staff. Check your belongings, then come this way. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票を二枚お持ちですね。受け取り方法のご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have two missed-delivery notices. Is this about collection methods?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ日に入っていたので、後の票が前の票の訂正版だと思っていました。一枚の番号だけで再配達の希望を出しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同日二枚を訂正版と思い一つの番号だけで再配達希望を出したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: They arrived the same day, so I thought the later one corrected the first. I requested redelivery using only one number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you mistook the same-day notices for a correction and requested redelivery for only one number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二枚の荷物番号が違いますね。少なくとも同じ番号の票ではありません。どちらの番号で希望を出したか、確認できるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The parcel numbers on the two notices are different. At least we can say they are not notices for the same number. Do you have anything showing which number you used for your request?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 送信後の保存画面があります。この票の番号と一致しますが、もう一枚の番号は入力していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 保存した送信画面が片方の番号のみと一致し他方は未入力と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I saved the screen after submitting the request. The number matches this notice, but I have not entered the number on the other one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the saved submission matches only one number and the other was not entered. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では入力した分の受付状況と、もう一件の扱いを分けて確認します。それぞれの保管期限も見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then I will check the status of the request you submitted separately from how the other parcel will be handled. Let us also check the storage deadline for each one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この二つの日付は配達される日だと思っていましたが、保管期限の欄なのですね。片方の希望を出しただけで両方延びるとは思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 票の日付が配達日でなく保管期限と理解し一件の希望で両期限延長と考えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought these two dates were delivery dates, but this is the storage-deadline field. I will not assume that submitting a request for one parcel extends the storage deadlines for both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Recognize storage deadlines rather than delivery dates, and say one request does not imply both are extended. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入力や希望だけで期限の変更が決まるとは限りません。もう一件について、窓口での受け取りも検討されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Entering information or submitting a request does not necessarily mean the storage deadline will change. Would you also consider collecting the other parcel at the counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 検討しますが、ここに荷物があるとはまだ確認できていません。保管場所と、私が受け取る場合の持ち物を先に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 窓口受取は検討するが現地保管未確認なので保管場所と本人受取持参物を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will consider that, but I have not yet confirmed that the parcel is here. Please first tell me where it is being stored and what I need to bring if I collect it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Consider counter collection but request storage location and required items first because local storage is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 番号ごとに保管場所と受け取り条件を照会します。二件とも同じ場所や同じ方法とは、今ここでは決めずに確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will look up the storage location and collection conditions for each parcel number. We will check rather than assume at this stage that both parcels are in the same place or can be received in the same way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二件を分けて、再配達希望を出した方の受付状況と、まだ希望を出していない方の保管場所・期限・持ち物をメモします。確認後にもう一件の方法を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 申込分の受付と未申込分の保管場所・期限・持参物を分けて控え方法を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep separate notes for the two parcels: the status of the redelivery request I submitted for one, and the storage location, deadline, and required items for the other, for which I have not submitted a request. After checking those details, I will choose how to receive the other parcel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will record the submitted request separately from the other's storage, deadline and required items before choosing a method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では二枚ともお手元に置いて、順に照会しましょう。まだ二件の受け取りが確定したわけではありません。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep both notices ready, and we will look them up one at a time. Arrangements for receiving both parcels have not yet been confirmed. Thank you for coming to discuss this.
